title: folk Review (2026)
intro: Relationship CRM with AI assistants, LinkedIn capture (folkX), enrichment, and collaborative pipelines for modern sales teams. This review covers verified pricing, core CRM capabilities, AI tooling, limitations, and who should buy — based on official first-party sources.
summary: folk is a solid CRM choice for founders and smb teams running relationship-led sales from linkedin/email. Scores reflect live first-party pricing/product research — not hands-on product testing.
verdict: folk is a solid CRM choice for founders and smb teams running relationship-led sales from linkedin/email. Scores reflect live first-party pricing/product research — not hands-on product testing.

criterionAssessments.rationale: folk is marketed as a beautifully simple relationship CRM with LinkedIn capture and AI assistants doing busywork.
Collaborative pipelines are included from Standard; deal objects deepen on Premium.
Workflow/Follow-up assistants are strong; sequences and higher automation credits skew Premium/Enterprise.
Email campaigns on Standard; sequences on Premium; Gmail/Microsoft sync documented.
Dashboards are Premium+; Standard is lighter on analytics depth.
Magic fields and Premium custom objects/deals provide solid process fit for relationship-led teams.
5,000+ integrations claim, Zapier/Make, WhatsApp sync, and API (Premium+) are well documented.
Simple defaults, but credit quotas and Premium role/permission controls add light governance work.
Enterprise custom limits and security help, but product remains relationship-CRM oriented vs enterprise suites.
Standard at $24 annual is competitive for AI-assisted relationship CRM; Premium doubles cost for deals/sequences/API.

sections.heading: What folk is
sections.body: Relationship CRM with AI assistants, LinkedIn capture (folkX), enrichment, and collaborative pipelines for modern sales teams. folk captures multi-channel relationship context so AI assistants can automate follow-ups, research, recaps, and outreach workflows.

sections.heading: Pricing and plans
sections.body: USD list prices from folk pricing page (Aug 2026): Standard $24/$30, Premium $48/$60, Enterprise from $80/$100 per member/mo (annual/monthly). 2-week (14-day) free trial of premium features, no credit card. FAQ confirms a free plan exists for downgrades; free feature matrix not fully shown on cards.

sections.heading: Core CRM capabilities
sections.body: Documented capabilities include: contact-management, lead-management, pipeline-management, deal-management, email-sync, email-campaigns, email-sequences, workflow-automation, sales-automation, reporting.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body: Best for: Founders and SMB teams running relationship-led sales from LinkedIn/email; Teams that want AI assistants on top of a simple CRM. Less ideal for: Phone-first outbound dialer teams; Buyers needing fully documented free-forever CRM feature matrices.
